data.title: Remove start command
data.body:
## Goal

Remove the `start` command since `docket work` handles the Approved → InProgress transition automatically.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Remove `Start` variant from `Commands` enum in `main.rs`
- [ ] Remove `start` from `pub use status::{approve, done, start}` in `commands/mod.rs`
- [ ] Remove `start()` function from `src/commands/status/transitions.rs`
- [ ] Update any documentation that mentions start

## Context

The `start` command was a manual way to transition a bug from Approved to InProgress. However, `docket work` does this automatically when launching a workspace. Having both is redundant - users should use `work` to start working on a bug.
